note: Nemaha County has no adopted county zoning; its Planning and Zoning page says zoning regulations are only proposed. The largest city, Auburn, publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (city-of-auburn-zoning-map.pdf) with no queryable ArcGIS service. Peru, Brownville and Nemaha villages showed no zoning GIS. ArcGIS searches for Nemaha County/Auburn zoning returned no service. County and city sites were partly blocked (HTTP 503), so this is based on what was reachable.
